name: Táin bó Cuialnge

attributes.attribute: variant spelling, fuller account under CATTLE RAID

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Táin bó Cuialnge is a variant spelling of the Irish epic. The fuller account appears under CATTLE RAID. That entry holds the tale of the raid and its heroes. The reader should follow the cross-reference for the complete story.

okr.objective: Point the reader from this spelling to the full Cattle Raid entry.
key_results: Names the CATTLE RAID entry as the place of the full account
